_comment: command-structure.json — field order for curated ARC commands.
Keys are full command strings: 'set address-group', 'update tag', etc.
Bare object names (e.g. 'address') are still accepted and get a 'set ' prefix.
Value: array of field names in the order the user types them.
required positionals first, optional keywords last.
Field metadata (choices, hints, required) lives in command_structure.py.
update <obj> and delete <obj> are AUTO-DERIVED from set <obj> entries:
update reuses the same fields; delete uses only 'name'.
Add an explicit entry to override.
You do NOT need quotes around values with spaces — ARC's greedy parser
works out field boundaries from the structure below.
Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored by the parser.
